name: Armory Protocol
subtitle: Suit Up, Deploy, Overwhelm
commander: Tony Stark // The Invincible Iron Man

sources.name: DEC-402 — board-approved Strategy A (Armory Voltron), owned-pool-first build
Scryfall oracle verification
sources.detail: Commander + all 99 cards verified against oracle text, 2026-07-06

guideContent.strategyOverview: Tony Stark's front face is a one-mana-per-activation periscope that digs four deep for the deck's 37 artifacts, assembling the armory while the mana base develops. At six mana (four with Training Grounds) he transforms into a 5/5 flying haste threat that deploys one artifact from hand per combat entirely free — Equipment attach directly to him, bypassing both cast and equip costs. The primary kill is 21 commander damage through free-attached blades: Excalibur, Sword of Eden keeps him airborne at 15 power, and adding Fireshrieker makes it a single-combat 30. The same deploy trigger doubles as a mana cheat for haymaker artifacts (Phyrexian Triniform, Ancient Stone Idol), so removal-heavy tables still face a stream of oversized threats. Blue backup counterspells protect the suit; if the commander plan stalls, Kappa Cannoneer, Cyberdrive Awakener, and Hellkite Tyrant win off raw artifact density.

deckCategories.name: The Armory
deckCategories.description: Kill-piece Equipment the back face attaches for free at each combat. Excalibur (+10/+0) keeps flying for a two-hit clock; Fireshrieker converts it into a one-combat 30. Colossus Hammer is +10/+10 but strips flying — it is deployed alongside Whispersilk Cloak, never as the lone plan. Living-weapon caveat: Kaldra Compleat deployed by the combat trigger is immediately re-attached to its Germ token (the living weapon trigger is mandatory and resolves after the deploy) - it arrives as an independent 5/5 first-strike indestructible body, and reaches the commander only via equip {7} or a later attach effect.

deckCategories.name: Flight Systems
deckCategories.description: Evasion and protection for the suit. Whispersilk Cloak grants unblockable plus shroud - the back face's attach trigger doesn't target, so the commander can still suit up while shrouded, but targeted helpers can't: Mithril Coat's flash ETB attach targets, so deploy the Coat via the combat trigger instead once the Cloak is on. Padeem gives the transformed commander (an artifact creature) and every Equipment hexproof; the untransformed front face is not an artifact and stays exposed.

deckCategories.name: Heavy Ordnance
deckCategories.description: Alternate free-deploy targets when the table answers the Voltron line. Each combat the back face can put one of these into play at zero mana; Nexus of Becoming adds a second deploy stream. Cyberdrive caveat: its entry animates every noncreature artifact, and an Equipment that becomes a creature falls off its bearer (state-based action) - cast it on a go-wide turn, not while the commander is suited, and re-deploy afterwards.

deckCategories.name: Attach Redundancy
deckCategories.description: Backup lines when the commander is answered. Armory Automaton attaches every Equipment to itself on entry or attack and Kazuul's Toll Collector re-suits for free each turn - both cheat equip costs outright. Shuri plays a different backup role: she discounts every artifact spell, and at sorcery speed she can turn an already-attached Equipment into a copy of Excalibur for the turn (the attachment survives the copy effect) to assemble lethal power a turn early.

deckCategories.name: R&D
deckCategories.description: Card flow and toolbox access. Tribute Mage fetches two-mana artifacts (Isochron Scepter), Trophy Mage the three-slot (Whispersilk Cloak, Fireshrieker, Mithril Coat), and Fabricate or Whir of Invention find anything.

deckCategories.name: Defense Grid
deckCategories.description: Counterspells to protect the transform, the suit, and the combo turn - Swan Song and Stubborn Denial are the cheapest holds (Stubborn is soft until the 5/5 is online, median T6). Flexible removal plus two red sweepers for behind positions; the commander rebuilds from the command zone faster than anyone.

deckCategories.name: Power Systems
deckCategories.description: Rocks and cost reducers that double as artifact-count fuel for Kappa Cannoneer, improvise, and Hellkite Tyrant's twenty-artifact clause. Training Grounds cuts the transform to {2}{U}{R} (the dig stays {1} — the effect can't reduce below one mana).

deckCategories.name: Overload Protocols
deckCategories.description: The bracket 4- combo layer, consistency-trimmed in the DEC-402 review round to the single reliable line. Isochron Scepter imprinting Dramatic Reversal with three-plus mana of rocks (or Urza) in play generates unbounded mana and untaps; Urza, Lord High Artificer is the deterministic outlet - {5}: play the entire library. Scepter is reachable by four tutors, Emry, and the dig; Reversal by Mystical Tutor. Scepter also imprints any of the deck's five cheap counters for fair-mode value. Fragility notes: Dramatic Reversal has no recursion in these colors - do not pitch it to Thirst for Knowledge, Big Score, or Windfall, and remember Emry's entry mill can bin it (Scepter can be rebought via Emry or Academy Ruins; Reversal cannot). The win is same-turn only with Urza on board; otherwise unbounded mana converts over a turn or two through the dig and Steel Hellkite.

synergies.title: One-combat commander kill
synergies.description: The back face attaches Excalibur free (+10/+0, flying retained → 15/5), and a prior-turn Fireshrieker makes it double strike: 30 commander damage in a single combat.

synergies.title: Hammer needs a cloak
synergies.description: Colossus Hammer is +10/+10 but the equipped creature loses flying. Whispersilk Cloak makes the 15/15 unblockable, and its shroud doesn't block the attach — the back face's trigger doesn't target the creature.

synergies.title: Cheap suit-up
synergies.description: Transform drops from {4}{U}{R} to {2}{U}{R}; the {1} dig activation is unaffected (Training Grounds can't reduce an ability below one mana).

synergies.title: Second deploy stream
synergies.description: Nexus of Becoming draws a card at each of your combats and can convert a card in hand into a 3/3 Golem token copy - the copy keeps abilities (Phyrexian Triniform still leaves three Golems, Ancient Stone Idol a 6/12) but its power/toughness become 3/3 and the exiled card is gone for good. Feed it spare threats, never Equipment kill pieces; the commander's own deploy trigger is the one that puts real cards onto the battlefield.

synergies.title: Armory recycling
synergies.description: Destroyed Equipment comes back: Emry recasts artifacts from the graveyard (cost cut by the deck's reducers), Academy Ruins tops the library with anything she can't reach.

synergies.title: Density payoffs
synergies.description: Thirty-seven artifacts turn on the deck's B-plan: Kappa grows unblockable with ward 4, Cyberdrive animates the rock suite for an alpha strike, and Hellkite Tyrant threatens the twenty-artifact win with Treasure support.

synergies.title: Backup attachers
synergies.description: Both cheat equip costs if the commander is answered — Armory Automaton grabs every Equipment on entry or attack, Kazuul's Toll Collector re-suits for free each turn.

synergies.title: Dramatic Scepter
synergies.description: With rocks producing three or more mana, each {2} activation copies Reversal, untapping everything for a net mana profit - unbounded mana and untaps. Tutorable from the artifact side (Tribute Mage, Fabricate, Whir, Emry) and the spell side (Mystical Tutor).

synergies.title: Urza powers the grid
synergies.description: Every artifact taps for {U} - rocks, Equipment, deployed bombs all become rituals. With Dramatic Scepter assembled, Urza converts unbounded mana into the full library via his {5} ability; in fair games he accelerates the transform and Whir's {U}{U}{U}.

winConditions.title: Commander damage via free-attached Equipment
winConditions.description: The transformed 5/5 flying haste commander attaches a kill piece free each combat: Excalibur alone is a two-hit clock in the air; with Fireshrieker it is 30 commander damage in one swing; Aettir and Priwen makes power equal to life total.

winConditions.title: Deployed arsenal beatdown
winConditions.description: Free deploys from the commander and Nexus of Becoming put 6-10 mana threats into play years ahead of schedule; Cyberdrive Awakener animates the artifact base for burst alpha strikes.

winConditions.title: Hellkite Tyrant artifact coup
winConditions.description: Twenty artifacts at upkeep wins outright; Treasure generation and stolen artifacts from Tyrant's combat trigger close the gap quickly in an artifact-dense deck.

winConditions.title: Dramatic Scepter
winConditions.description: Unbounded mana and untaps with three-plus rock mana in play (trivial with Urza turning every artifact into a blue ritual). Urza is the deterministic outlet - {5}: play the entire library. Without him it still converts through Tony's dig, Emry graveyard recasts, and lethal Steel Hellkite firebreathing.
